meta.signConvention: ethDelta is the TRADER's ETH (currency0) delta as emitted by v4. Negative = trader pays ETH into the pool (buy HOOKR, zeroForOne=true). Positive = trader receives ETH from the pool (sell HOOKR, zeroForOne=false). The pool's ETH delta is -ethDelta.
meta.priceConvention: HOOKR priced in ETH = 1.0001^(-tick). Tick RISING = HOOKR FALLING. Leverage collateral (HOOKR) loses value as tick rises.

fullSampled.note: every 90th swap across the pool's whole life (36242 swaps, 9.16 days). Preserves the size distribution and the long-run 74x drift; DESTROYS microstructure/autocorrelation.

crashWindow.note: contiguous, unsampled 400-swap window centred on the steepest 10-minute collapse (blocks 29084809..29088942, -74.6% in ~10 min). Use this as the liquidation-stress path.

recentWindow.note: contiguous, unsampled last 400 swaps up to head block 36965170 — the pool's current, calmer regime.
